inputs.title: Site and restricted test scope
inputs.question: Which actual site/cell, permitted test scope, data restrictions and authority records govern this campaign?

inputs.title: Installed platform combination
inputs.question: Which hardware, product, API, provider, backend, feature and licence combination is actually selected, supported and entitled?

inputs.title: Security-edge implementation and contexts
inputs.question: Which supported implementation owns each domain attachment, routing context, policy, inspection, HA and management boundary?

inputs.title: Offered address families
inputs.question: Which families are actually offered, and which bootstrap, local-control, service, MTU and recovery dependencies support them?

inputs.title: Configuration and observation ownership
inputs.question: Who is the single writer and independent observer for each native object, service binding, state scope and handoff?

inputs.title: Bootstrap trust and transfer
inputs.question: Which temporary name/time/identity/key/image dependencies permit installation, who controls them, and how is custody transferred safely?

inputs.title: Management and OOB recovery
inputs.question: Which actual administration and recovery paths remain controlled and usable under the declared outage?

inputs.title: Transport and attachment capacity
inputs.question: Which accepted transport, physical handoffs, route ownership and measured MTU budget support the selected platform and edge?

inputs.title: Authoritative allocation and reuse
inputs.question: Where are the real owned allocations, family selections, reservations, reuse constraints and lifecycle receipts?

inputs.title: Name and initialization services
inputs.question: Which actual clients use resolvers, authoritative registration, DHCP/metadata and image initialization, with which permitted operations and reply paths?

inputs.title: Time profile
inputs.question: Which client-specific protocol, integrity, reachability, drift/failure limits and recovery behaviour are selected?

inputs.title: Image/template provenance
inputs.question: Which image/template, boot mode, devices, initialization and retained-source provenance are accepted for the selected platform?

inputs.title: Placement and co-residency
inputs.question: Which host/storage pools are eligible during allocation, restart, evacuation and restore, and what shared dependencies remain?

inputs.title: Client identity and resource entitlement
inputs.question: Which actual guest, host, proxy, runner and administrator identities have which endpoint and data permissions?

inputs.title: Certificates, keys and recovery custody
inputs.question: Which consumers use each credential/key, how are trust and revocation checked, and what survives loss of the protected platform?

inputs.title: Storage and copy lifecycle
inputs.question: Which virtual-disk, guest file/object, replication, copy/export and administration paths exist, and who retains or sanitizes each copy?

inputs.title: Capture, transfer and isolated restore
inputs.question: Which capture method, management/data clients, independent copy authority, catalogue and key recovery paths are selected?

inputs.title: Attribution and collection loss
inputs.question: Which independently controlled collectors receive native events, with what attribution, latency, buffering and loss response?

inputs.title: Surviving capacity and reservations
inputs.question: Do all resource commitments, temporary probes, contexts, sessions, inspection and recovery loads fit the same measured failure basis?

inputs.title: Recovery target and fencing
inputs.question: Which eligible target, consistency point, positive writer exclusion and isolated useful-data checks support the promised recovery scope?

inputs.title: Retirement and retained obligations
inputs.question: Which live dependencies are removed, which copies/keys remain, who owns them, and when can identities/addresses be reused?

inputs.title: Stage-specific readiness and authority
inputs.owner_role: Service owner and relevant accepting authorities
inputs.question: Where are actual G0/G1/G2 decisions, applicable initial G4 readiness, current authority and the scoped G3 decision?

work_packages.title: Select the actual service and test scope
work_packages.deliverable: Owner-reviewed site design, supported combination and explicitly restricted test authority.
work_packages.hold_point: Unknown site, support, sharing or authority remains open.

work_packages.title: Establish recoverable bootstrap
work_packages.deliverable: Minimum independent administration, trust and supported installation dependencies.
work_packages.hold_point: Do not revoke bootstrap custody before its replacement is demonstrated.

work_packages.title: Accept fabric and attachment capacity
work_packages.deliverable: Observed transport, inventory, physical handoffs and G1 acceptance for their offered scope.
work_packages.hold_point: No consumer counts staged or merely purchased capacity as commissioned.

work_packages.title: Install platforms and common services under restricted authority
work_packages.deliverable: Installed platforms and service endpoints, jointly baselined; not yet advertised to ordinary tenants.
work_packages.hold_point: Installer completion does not replace joint P2/P3 service acceptance.

work_packages.title: Prepare denied test domains
work_packages.deliverable: Two owned tenant scopes, four independent OZ/RZ instances and observed effective quarantine.
work_packages.hold_point: No workload connection before the actual deny mechanism is verified.

work_packages.title: Create disposable endpoints and restricted observations
work_packages.deliverable: Owned disposable endpoints, healthy positive controls and separately authorized native observations.
work_packages.hold_point: A restricted test exception is not ordinary placement or production activation.

work_packages.title: Clean up the restricted fixture or discovered partial effects
work_packages.deliverable: Resource-owner reconciliation, removal of scoped temporary access/probes and transfer of retained data/key obligations. Trigger on test completion or safe stop, independently of qualification success.
work_packages.hold_point: Known owner scope and separately authorized cleanup of actual discovered effects are required; failed bootstrap, installation or test stages do not have to succeed before safe stop or cleanup.

work_packages.title: Review exact offered capability
work_packages.deliverable: Reviewed operation coverage, negative/positive observations, limits and offered service envelope.
work_packages.hold_point: Unknown or failed mandatory observations do not become a qualified capability.

work_packages.title: Establish initial operating and recovery readiness
work_packages.deliverable: Operating custody, incident/support routes and observed recovery required by the actual service promise.
work_packages.hold_point: Recurring later exercises do not substitute for applicable initial readiness.

work_packages.title: Review a separate production change
work_packages.deliverable: Separately reviewed production resources, current evidence, explicit authority and reversible activation design.
work_packages.hold_point: This planning kit neither creates nor activates those resources.

work_packages.title: Operate, requalify and retire
work_packages.deliverable: Observed lifecycle, retained-copy ownership and applicable recurring operating acceptance.
work_packages.hold_point: Use the cleanup procedure even after failed tests; never require a successful production stage to remove a hazardous test fixture.

observations.title: Routing completeness
observations.control: Prove permitted source-to-destination and established reply traffic with healthy endpoints before evaluating a missing or blocked path.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record native route/forwarding snapshots at both ends and every handoff, packet correlation, interfaces, policy hit evidence and alternate-path review.
observations.safe_stop: Do not interpret missing routes as observed firewall denial. Freeze changes if ownership or the return path is uncertain.

observations.title: Service and resource isolation
observations.control: Show the same credential/path can reach its approved endpoint and entitled resource, while the foreign/admin target is healthy.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Separate endpoint reachability, protocol success, identity acceptance and resource entitlement; retain the actual denied operation and enforcement evidence.
observations.safe_stop: Stop exposure on a foreign resource or management success; preserve data and investigation evidence.

observations.title: Mandatory control ownership
observations.control: Demonstrate an approved mutation with the actual delegated tenant role before attempting forbidden mutations in the isolated scope.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record role/policy scope, attempted native operation, denial, unchanged effective policy and absence of permissive alternate paths.
observations.safe_stop: Use a reversible test account/scope; never trial forbidden changes in an unrelated tenant or production resource.

observations.title: Address-family completeness
observations.control: Prove known allowed paths separately for every offered family; identify unsupported or not-offered families without calling them passed.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record family-specific allocation, neighbour/source controls, PMTU/MTU, service reply and recovery observations for the actual path.
observations.safe_stop: Do not silently disable or translate a family to make a requested service appear complete.

observations.title: Resolver protocol completeness
observations.control: Use a healthy approved resolver and known small/large answers; verify client and resolver observability before negative cases.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Distinguish UDP, direct TCP and truncation/fallback, approved resolver selection, alternative resolver denial and authoritative registration.
observations.safe_stop: Do not infer authoritative DNS or IPAM acceptance from a recursive lookup.

observations.title: Intra-domain controls
observations.control: Add a separately scoped temporary probe when one endpoint per domain cannot exercise the required same-domain path.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record actual same-host and cross-host placement when eligible, both allowed and denied relationships and unchanged unrelated domains.
observations.safe_stop: Reserve probe capacity, retain eligibility during evacuation, and remove probe resources and credentials afterward.

observations.title: Admission accounting
observations.control: Establish units, measurement conditions and the same covered failure before comparing demand and surviving capability.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record compute, data, contexts, routing, sessions, inspection, telemetry, API and test/recovery demand without adding unlike units.
observations.safe_stop: Reject unsupported commitments; never relax policy or placement to fit a capacity limit.

observations.title: Uncertain native execution
observations.control: Use an authorized disposable operation with recorded native identity and distinguish stopped runner from actual writer exclusion.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record task and resource discovery, current scope/generation, lease/fencing evidence, partial effects and absence of duplicate allocation.
observations.safe_stop: No blind resubmit, forced unlock or automatic deletion; preserve current incident containment.

observations.title: Activation dependencies
observations.control: Use a harmless local decision rehearsal or separately authorized fixture; no production permit is created by this worksheet.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record actual stage decisions and show a proposed activation is held when applicable initial readiness or current authority is absent.
observations.safe_stop: Any tool summary is evidence for review, not an activation token or proof of approval authenticity.

observations.title: Shared-service and control loss
observations.control: Capture healthy service/deny controls before the approved fault and recovery; maintain independent management and test observers.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record affected clients, detection, retained enforcement, buffering/session/retry behaviour, surviving capacity and restored service.
observations.safe_stop: Honor the fault budget and stop conditions; do not disable host security or mandatory enforcement to keep the test running.

observations.title: Retained recovery and retirement
observations.owner_role: Data, backup, key and lifecycle owners
observations.control: Prove useful data at a named consistency point and authorized key/catalogue access in an isolated eligible target.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record capture versus transfer paths, independent retention/deletion roles, restore validation, writer fencing and post-retirement retained custody.
observations.safe_stop: Removing a live WSD is not permission to destroy retained data or keys; preserve obligations and deny unauthorized destruction.

observations.title: Second-stack outcome and exit
observations.control: Qualify the first stack without requiring this cross-stack proof, then repeat the declared outcomes on a separately eligible second stack.
observations.evidence_to_collect: Record equivalent permitted/denied paths and representative useful-data recovery/exit, including changed native identities and explicit extension limits.
observations.safe_stop: Do not claim portability from disk conversion, identical object names or two unrelated successful deployments.
